name: induction-strike-graveyard-ability-pays-one-and-adds-a-static-counter
notes: Induction Strike: (1), banish from the graveyard: static counter on target arcane object. Pre-fix unusable.

rulesClauses: (1), Banish this card from your graveyard: Put a static counter on target arcane element object you control and each object linked to it.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The engine had no route from a graveyard click to the generated ability bodies (only hand-coded per-card blocks), so this ability could not be used / was never paid. GAFieldAbilityCostTable() entries flagged 'graveyard' now pay the (N) and banish the card, and ActionMap() routes the click through ActivateAbility.
